events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, dying six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, the impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message still resonates. A true icon.

events.title: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His influence on rock music remains monumental.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the tracks within!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead vocalist of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock'n'Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that swagger to the stage. As you were.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Peace Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as ever.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It changed everything about carrying your music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme song? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. So much musical genius in one package!

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years on, the voice and stage presence of Freddie Mercury are still unmatched. Remembering a true legend today.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was murdered on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
